Text.Text: Supplier
Fulfills delivery orders for residents in the surrounding area. Note: This Area Effect only affects Residences but is allowed to stack on them. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Unconventional Pet Breeder
"Pigs and sheep can also be kept as pets." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Irresponsible Arms Trader
"Everyone should have at least one, if not several, weapons! What could possibly go wrong?" (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Practice-oriented Instructor
"Only through practice you can solidify knowledge!... Ouch! Medicus!" (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Independent Sculptor
Uses the best stone in the region to create busts of his clients. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Local Carpenter
Is responsible for the maintenance of all nearby buildings. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Nova Fibbularia, Renowned Brooch Designer
Her brooches are the most sought-after in the entire kingdom. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"I more silver BARS! Not the Ore!" (300 silver in storage)
Occultia, Fish Reader
"The guts are telling me... you'll find your true love. Soon..." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Talented Artistic Cook
Cooking is like an inspiring performance. But who’s going to clean up the mess? (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Without a solid basis nothing can be done in my kitchen!" (300 flour in storage)
Pa-nefer, Cuddly Pillow Manufacturer
"I wonder if it's possible to make pillows shaped like sharks? Carcharias Softis would be absolutely amazing!" (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Strictus Vaporosus II, Safety Paragraph Rider

"According to Section 5, Subsection 2 A of the Roman Fire Safety Regulations, this fireplace may only be used between sunrise and the noon assembly! Subsection 12, G, also states...." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Cernunia Aricin, Green Alchemist
Her alchemy might even benefit the general health of the community.. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Experienced Headrest Upholsterer
His headpieces are surprisingly sturdy. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
The Invisible Amphora Artist
This citizen uses a technique to make amphorae highly fire-resistant. However, no one knows his name... and he hardly stands out. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
He wants to blend in with the crowd. (5000 Population on Island)
He-Ma-Te, Inspiring Lyre Maker
The sound of their lyres inspires all listeners to new innovations. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Wants to be part of a lyre collegium. (8x Lyremaker on Island)
Glano Tascio, Perfectionist Carriage Builder
His fast and sturdy chariots are ideal for racing. Even when serving for the Auxillia, his Celtic mettle shines through. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Requires multiple test sites for the war chariots. (2x Equitum Campus on Island)
Livia Lectuaria, The Cunning Queen of Loungers

"Anyone who dozes off on a Lectuaria lounger has already decided to buy it. Taking a nap is considered a binding declaration of intent to purchase the piece of furniture. No returns due to drool stains." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Looking for a sufficiently large customer base. (150 Patrician Residences on Island)
Manlius Portus Magnus, Praebitor Maximus

He bought up the entire supply of Aegyptian papyrus just to fold it into shipping boxes and supply every single store, no matter how small, with them. Surprisingly, everyone uses his service. Note: This area effect only affects residential buildings but can stack. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Needs a sufficiently large customer base for his shipping boxes. (42x Production Buildings on Island)
Vercanomagus, Creative Tailor
He often asks himself: “How can you pair a toga with pants?” (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
He is a regular at the Medicus. (10x Medicus on Island)
Bevera, Protective Hatmaker
Their hats can withstand any storm everywhere. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Has problems to start sleeping. (300 Sheep in Storage)
Lucius Capillus Calvus, The Hair Oracle
"Go to Calvus if you don't want to be a Calvus anymore." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Likes to test whether his wigs stays intact in water. (4x Aqueduct Cistern/Distributor on Island)
Narcissicus, the sturdy Mirrormaker
No soul will ever be hurt and need seven years to heal, because his mirrors can never break. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Travels from Fanum to Fanum to heal his own soul. (4x Fanum on Island)
Decima Rima, Artifex Fragilis
"How am I supposed to sell more glass if it never breaks?" (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Taverns are her new main customers. (10x Taverns on Island)
Malleator Linguis, Tongue Hammerer
His way of preparing bird tongues makes the taste a little more bearable. I wonder what role the hammer plays in that? (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
He's regularly suspected of murder. To be on the safe side, there should always be a few guards with him. (9x Custodes on Island)
Phileros, Saponarius Amoris
With his new formula, he adds fresh, soft scents to the soap and brings a touch of Amor to the streets. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
He'd like to live on a beautiful island.(5000 Prestige on Island)
Lucius Braciarius, Master of the beer.
His studies showed him the perfect mixture for a good beer. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Mixing herbs into beer preserves the flavor for generations." (400 herbs in storage)
Pistorius Ambrosius, Good smelling Baker
Is it his bread, or is it...uh... him that smells so good? (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
His Bread is looked upon on by Ceres. (6x Shrine of Ceres on Island)
Bairbre Ní Chasaide, Experienced Cheesemaker
Her cheese is treated like a special delicacy. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"A greek scribe once told me a cheese varity can be obtained from sheep. I will need to test this." (3x Sheep Pastures on Island)
Fiona Ní Mháille, Cloakmaker
Everyone is clamoring for Fiona's coats. Luckily, they can’t tear. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Uses a special bronze stamp to mark her cloaks. (500 bronze in storage)
Cian Cearnach, The Ever-Celebrating Horner
"My Horns have been and will be at every festival! Lets celebrate!" (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Without a good bard there is nothing to celebrate!" (6x Bardic Hearth on Island)
Flavia Lepida, Finest Preparer of Garum
"The taste compensates for the smell during fermentation." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"My garum is only allowed to be served in the finest glass you have." (350x Fine Glass in Storage)
Valerius Trepidus, concerned Commander
Although the emperor has proclaimed the Pax, Valerius remains tense. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Is calmed down by a strong army. (At least 20 Troops anywhere. Garrison does not count)
Musica Fabra, humming Artisan
Their craftsmanship is accompanied by music. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Mosaics in different colors are their muse. (400x Mosaics in Storage)
Livia Acuscula, Up-and-coming Seamstress
Her clothing has prevailed over the competition. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Only competition keeps her inner fire burning. (30x Clothiers on Island)
Vibius Fontinalis, Green-eyed Craftsman
His green eyes are reflected so beautifully in any liquid. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Always in need of fresh drinkable water. (10x Wells on Island)
Quintus Faber, Inventive Craftsman
"My ideas must be tested in practice." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Tries to find different perspectives and ideas. (24x Workshops on Island)
Numisia Rapax, Ruthless Gem Cutter
Ruthlessly chases after every gold bar. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Gold? GOOOOOOLLLLD?! Goooooooooooooooold!" (500x Gold in Storage)
Casperius Olearius, Quality Oilmaker
"Olive Oil is an nessesity for your everyday life." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Glass keeps the quality of my oil high." (300x Glass in Storage)
Aiacia Plancia, Ostrearia Magnifica
Knows how to make oyster platters look appetizing. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Where is my collection of sea shells?" (100x Sea Shells in Storage)
Aisling, Seasoner of the Meat
"Any meat can be made edible. Leave it to me." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Seasons the meat with some small white corn. (200x Salt in Storage)
Theone Psais, Tunic Weaver from Aegyptus
Her tunics are known throughout Aegyptus. Now, she is in your service. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Everyone will get a special tunic from me. Let me get my strings..." (150x Strings in Storage)
Banuhsch Turanbakht, Parthian Tablet Translator
Translates texts from distant Persia into Latin. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Only Scholars and Scribes are interested. (8000 Knowledge on Island)
Augusta Vinaria, Exquisite Wine Mistress
Ruler of the grapes. At least of her own. (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"Having a grape now and then has never ruined anyone’s day." (300x Grapes in Storage)
Livia Pultaria, Refreshing Porridge Cook
“Come along and let my porridge strengthen you.” (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
"A kraut from Albion lets the porridge taste much better." (300 Saltwort in Storage)
Valeria Caligaria, Sturdy Sandal-Maker
"Without good sandals, you won't have a firm footing." (Altdolphin-Industry-AreaEffects-Pack)
Often gets lost and needs statues for orientation. (25 Statues on Island)
